Flow.description: #29846 Updated the flow to invoke apex class to assign permission set to the user in asynchronus call # 29581 Updated the flow to enable self registration for FRA/ESP/DEU. #28959 - Assign User to the Permission Set. #28842 - Update caseorigin through the community site configuration metadata. #22767 - create user with user domain if the user is from diff domain #21139- redirect to forgot password page for the existing user #21516 - redirected to Case Creation when Contact Account does not match with Customer Account's Account. #24495 - A new contact record should be automatically created and associated with the account that is associated with the customer account. #26206 - Created user's country will be based on Site Language #27223 - Updated the flow to get the locale, Timezone , Currency from the Community Site Configuration metadata to create user acordingly, #26938 - Updated the flow to allow phone number field to UKI format #28347,#28348 - Updated the flow to allow UKI countries(UK, Germany, France, Spain and Austria) to self registration #28657 - Added Division to the user creation # GitLab:31617 , #31678, #31684, #31828, #31820,#31851, #31842 #32540:Updated the flow to enable self registration for APAC region(India, Malaysia,Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, Taiwan, South Korea, Indonesia English). #GitLab - Updated the Customer ID logic for Indonesia and Korea to allow 4-6 Alpha Numeric Characters

formulas.name: Description
formulas.expression: "First Name : " + {!First_Name} +", Last Name : " + {!Last_Name} + IF({!varTxt_PhoneNumber} != '',", Phone :" + {!varTxt_PhoneNumber} , '') + ", Email : " + {!Email} + IF({!varF_CustomerIdForDesc} !='' ,", Customer ID : "+{!varF_CustomerIdForDesc},'') + IF({!Account_Company_Name} != '',", Account/Company Name :" + {!Account_Company_Name}, '')+ IF({!Account_Company_Name_UKI} != '',", Account/Company Name :" + {!Account_Company_Name_UKI}, '')

formulas.description: #21139 - as a part of this story updating redirection to forgot password page. GitLab: #31617, #31678, #31684,#31828 - Updated the formula to redirect the respective forgot password pages based on the country. APAC(India, Malaysia, Singapore,Indonesia)

formulas.description: Create a user with the user's domain if the multiple users are having same name from the diff domain

formulas.expression: LEFT({!Email}, FIND('@', {!Email}) - 1) + '.' + MID({!Email}, FIND('@', {!Email}) + 1, FIND('.', MID({!Email}, FIND('@', {!Email}) + 1, LEN({!Email}))) - 1) + '@ironmountain.exp'
